verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents its own DIY state backend, which stores state in an object store you manage (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage), and its pricing page lists self-hosting. Together these let users control where state data lives, which a community comment also notes ('option of self management'). However, region or residency selection is never addressed explicitly, and the hosted Pulumi Cloud backend shows no documented region choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency options for Pulumi Cloud, first-party residency documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of residency control.
